title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-14 21:25:33 最新章节：第三千三百七十八章 花千玥的心思
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
昆仑山外。
一个身穿黑色长裙，身材高挑，体态轻盈的绝美的少女，飞快的在丛林中掠过。
身后不远处，几名黑袍人紧追不舍。
“安妙菱，宗主已经准备立你为圣女，你为何要逃？”
安妙菱冷哼一声没有理会。
魔宗的宗主立她为圣女，无非是因为她体质特殊，想在她身上种下魔种。
种下魔种后，自己就会成为他的鼎炉，从此沦落为他的玩物。
这种伎俩，作为绝情女帝转世的她怎么看会不明白。
竟然重活一世。
任何人，任何事都不能阻止她变强。
这一世。
她要把太上忘情录修炼到极致，然后再去复仇。
从此斩断因果，孑然一身，只问大道。
说到复仇，她的神色冷了下来。
那一次她和三位帝境强者联手寻宝，但没想到这是一个局。
为了击杀她的局。
……
昆仑山内。
昆仑剑宗，藏剑峰。
今天是昆仑剑宗招收弟子的日子。

秦天作为藏剑峰的峰主，他需要去走个过场。
藏剑峰只有他一个人，所以他不准备招人，也没人愿意入藏剑峰。
因为在外人眼里他只是一个灵动境的低阶修者。
而他也只想当一个躺平青年。
招收弟子的地方叫仙缘台。
仙缘台上有十个席位，昆仑九峰每个峰主一席。
宗主，莫问天一席。
秦天坐到自己席位后，就拿出一本书悠闲的看了起来。
莫问天一看到秦天这懒散的样子就来气：
“你看看你，每天不是种草药，就是逗弄鱼鸟，大好年华全荒废了。”
“真不知道当初江师妹怎么看上你的。”
“宗主息怒，江师妹作为本宗数千年以来，唯一的圣境尊者，自然有她独特的眼光。”
说话的是玉剑峰的峰主苏岚，她和藏剑峰上一任峰主江轻雪是好友。
所以看在江轻雪的面子上，他会对对秦天照顾一二。
苏岚不说还好，一说莫问天更恼火了，“还独特的眼光，你看他那里独特了？”
苏岚尴尬的笑了笑道，“可能是时机未到吧。”
秦天朝着苏岚善意的笑了笑，没有太在意莫向天的话。
十五年前他本是世俗一个富家子弟。
江轻雪外出历练时受重伤，刚好被四处游玩的秦天碰上。
content_en:
Outside Kunlun Mountains.
A beautiful girl wearing a long black dress, tall and light, flew quickly through the jungle.
Not far behind him, several men in black robes were chasing after him.
"An Miaoling, the sect master is ready to make you a saint, why are you running away?"
An Miaoling snorted and ignored it.
The head of the Demon Sect made her a saint simply because of her special constitution and wanted to plant a demon seed in her body.
After planting the demon seed, you will become his cauldron and become his plaything from then on.
How could she not understand this kind of trick as the reincarnation of the ruthless empress.
He actually lived a new life.
No one or anything can stop her from becoming stronger.
This life.
She wants to practice Taishang Wangqinglu to the extreme, and then take revenge.
From then on, the cause and effect are cut off, and I am alone, only asking about the great road.
Speaking of revenge, her expression turned cold.
That time she teamed up with three emperor-level experts to hunt for treasure, but she didn't expect it to be a trap.
In order to kill her.
…
In the Kunlun Mountains.
Kunlun Sword Sect, Hidden Sword Peak.
Today is the day for Kunlun Sword Sect to recruit disciples.
As the peak master of Hidden Sword Peak, Qin Tian needs to go through the motions.
He is the only one in Hidden Sword Peak, so he is not planning to recruit anyone, and no one is willing to join Hidden Sword Peak.
Because in the eyes of outsiders, he is just a low-level cultivator in the spiritual realm.
And he just wants to be a young man who lies down.
The place where disciples are recruited is called Xianyuan Terrace.
There are ten seats on the Immortal Platform, one for each peak master of the nine Kunlun peaks.
Sect Master, don’t ask for a seat.
After Qin Tian sat down in his seat, he took out a book and started reading leisurely.
Mo Wentian became angry when he saw Qin Tian's lazy look:
"Look at you, every day you are either planting herbs or teasing fish and birds. All your good years are wasted."
"I really don't know why Junior Sister Jiang fell in love with you in the first place."
"Sect Master, please calm down. Junior Sister Jiang, as the only Saint Realm venerable in our sect for thousands of years, naturally has her unique vision."
The speaker was Su Lan, the peak master of Jade Sword Peak. She was good friends with Jiang Qingxue, the previous peak master of Hidden Sword Peak.
So for Jiang Qingxue's sake, he would take care of Qin Tian.
Su Lan didn't say it was okay, but when she said it Mo Wentian became even more annoyed, "He also has a unique vision. Do you think he is unique?"
Lidya Su smiled awkwardly and said, "Maybe the time has not come yet."
Qin Tian smiled kindly at Su Lan and didn't pay much attention to Mo Xiangtian's words.
Fifteen years ago, he was a kid from a wealthy family.
Jiang Qingxue was seriously injured while going out for training, and happened to be bumped into by Qin Tian who was wandering around.
